summary: S3 Storage Toggle Feature - All tests passed. Backend: 10/10 tests passed (100%). Frontend: UI verified working with toggle, toast notifications, and System Admin visibility control.
critical_code_review_comments: s3_storage.py check_cloud_resources_enabled(): Correctly checks cache first, then looks up main_site -> environment -> s3_enabled. Returns 403 with correct message when disabled.
s3_storage.py invalidate_s3_cache(): Properly clears the entire cache when s3_enabled is toggled.
environments.py PUT /{env_id}: Correctly handles s3_enabled field update and calls invalidate_s3_cache() when changed. Requires system admin.
EnvironmentManager.js: Cloud Resources toggle is wrapped in {isSystemAdmin && ...} - correctly hidden from non-system admins.
EnvironmentManager.js toggleS3(): Correctly calls PUT /api/environments/{env_id} with s3_enabled toggle and shows toast notification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: S3 toggle feature fully tested. Backend tests verify: (1) PUT /api/environments/{env_id} with s3_enabled=false disables S3, (2) Media upload to disabled env returns 403 with 'Cloud Resources are disabled. Please contact Clara Support.', (3) Re-enabling S3 allows uploads again, (4) Cache invalidation works correctly. Frontend UI shows Cloud Resources toggle only for System Admins, with toast notifications on toggle.
